context.title: Region approves transit fare increase starting in January
context.text: Region approves transit fare increase starting in January www.cbc.ca Regional council voted 11-5 on Tuesday to raise adult cash fares by 25 cents, the first increase in three years. Staff said rising fuel and labour costs left a projected shortfall of about $4 million for next year. "This is unacceptable," said one councillor who opposed the motion, arguing the increase would fall hardest on riders who have no alternative. The chair will be at Parliament Hill on Monday to ask Ottawa for transit funding. Monthly passes rise to $96 and the student pass is unchanged. The new fares take effect Jan. 1. Sept. 15, 2026
